definitions.gloss: stubborn, inflexible, set in one's ways
definitions.explanation: Describes someone who is unwilling to accept new ideas or change their way of thinking.

examples.japanese: うちの{父|ちち}は{頭|あたま}が{固|かた}い。
examples.english: My father is set in his ways.

examples.japanese: {頭|あたま}が{固|かた}い{上司|じょうし}で{困|こま}っている。
examples.english: I'm having trouble with my inflexible boss.

examples.japanese: そんなに{頭|あたま}が{固|かた}いことを{言|い}わないで。
examples.english: Don't be so rigid about it.

examples.japanese: {頭|あたま}が{固|かた}いと、{新|あたら}しい{考|かんが}え{方|かた}が{入|はい}ってこない。
examples.english: If you're inflexible, new ways of thinking won't get through to you.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}いのに{頭|あたま}が{固|かた}くて、いつも「{前|まえ}からこうだった」と{言|い}う。もう{少|すこ}し{柔軟|じゅうなん}に{考|かんが}えてほしい。
examples.english: Despite being young, he's rigid and always says 'that's how it's always been.' I wish he'd think more flexibly.

notes:
STRUCTURE: {頭|あたま} (head) + が + {固|かた}い (hard). Literally 'one's head is hard' - implying thoughts can't get through or change.

ANTONYM: {頭|あたま}が{柔|やわ}らかい (flexible in thinking, open-minded)

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {頑固|がんこ} (stubborn) - more general stubbornness
- {融通|ゆうずう}が{利|き}かない (inflexible, unbending)
- {保守的|ほしゅてき} (conservative)

CONTRAST:
- {頭|あたま}が{固|かた}い: unwilling to change thinking
- {頭|あたま}がいい/{悪|わる}い: intelligence (smart/not smart)
- {石頭|いしあたま} (stone head) - even stronger criticism of stubbornness

NUANCE: Often used critically, implying the person should be more open-minded.
